Sounds like it was a good meeting. Some hard facts to deal with when going Agile, particularly when it comes to cutting folks from the team that don’t meld with the new flow.

The absence of a product manager during development (in lieu of a live customer) is also a big problem, particularly when it comes to the continuous feedback needed. The here today, gone for two months ProdMgr is a major hang up when it comes time to deliver the software.

> He only tracks burn-down of an iteration as well as builds

You must have been distracted by the new baby pictures when he showed two slides of code analysis metrics
